description: Make the collision of a model on this machine with the SAME code as the GripForge service (same Rust tool, same description gripforge.collision/1, same cache key). The tool analyses the model (concavity, proportions, size, usage, static or mobile) and CHOOSES the method (none, box, compound, convex, convex_decomposition, trimesh) unless the passport imposes one; the answer carries the method, the score and the reason. From the passport of the model (kits.collision, then the game's override). With game it reads what each bound model needs, makes only the missing ones and gives them to the server; it also returns the level check (warnings). Never add a collision by hand to a game: fix the passport. Guide: gripforge_docs { topic: "collision" }. 0 credits.

advice.description: game only: ask the optional AI advice of the service on the ambiguous choices (on request only; the reason then says "AI advice: …").

bin.description: The collision binary gripforge-collision, for a platform without a prebuilt one.

check.description: Only the level check: the warnings (massive fixed decor without collision), nothing made for a game.

dry_run.description: game only: say what is missing, make nothing.

force_advice.description: game only, with advice: ask it for every model, not only the ambiguous ones.

game.description: A Game Kit project (gkp_…): its bound models. The server says what each needs (effective passport: global, then the game's own asset_passports); the missing collisions are made here and kept by the server (or made by the service with server: true).

kind.description: prop, character, enemy, creatures… decides the usage defaults.

kit.description: A LOD kit folder you have (lod-kit.mjs); default: the release published with the CLI, checked and cached.

mobile.description: A moving object: never a triangle mesh.

override.description: The game's keys over the passport (kits.collision): shape, usage, mobile, maxParts, maxHullPoints, maxTriangles, resolution, small, parts.

passport.description: Absolute path of the global passport of the model (.gfmesh.json). Default: <name>.gfmesh.json beside the model.

path.description: Absolute path of a model (.glb) or of a folder of models. Use this, or game.

push.description: game only; default true: send the descriptions made to the server.

server.description: game only: the GripForge service makes the missing ones instead of this machine.

shape.description: Impose a method (kits.collision.shape): auto (the tool chooses, default), none (traversable), box, compound, convex, convex_decomposition, trimesh (static decor only).

usage.description: What the asset is (default: from its kind and category): decides the choice (ground, wall and structure → mesh or boxes; small objects stay traversable).

name: gripforge_collision_build
title: Collision of models, made locally (with the choice and its reason)
